assertions.title: File tree loads root directory on component mount
test_names: Step 9: Files tab renders file explorer
assertions.notes: Step 9 (lines 771-819) asserts root entries 'src' and 'README.md' render in the FileEditorPanel after clicking the Files tab. However, the spec uses page.route() mocks (mockFileTreeRoot at lines 492-509) — it does NOT verify a real GET request to /agents/{agent}/files/tree is issued, nor that the response 'path' field is '' (root). Partial because the UI-visible outcome is exercised but the network contract is not verified.

assertions.title: First agent auto-selected from dropdown
test_names: Step 9: Files tab renders file explorer
assertions.notes: The expected_result has two parts: (a) dropdown shows first agent highlighted, (b) tree populated with that agent's files. Step 9 verifies (b) — the tree populates with the ember agent's mocked files after navigating to the agent detail panel. It does NOT verify (a) — the agent dropdown's auto-selection/highlighting of the first agent is not asserted. Partial coverage.

assertions.title: Switching agent refreshes tree
assertions.notes: No spec exercises switching the selected agent in the file tree and verifying the tree transitions to show the new agent's files with no cross-agent mixing. agent-review-journey.spec.ts only navigates to a single agent (ember).

assertions.title: Directory expansion fetches child entries
test_names: Step 9: Files tab renders file explorer
assertions.notes: Step 9 clicks the 'src' directory button (lines 793-797) and asserts 'auth.go' and 'auth_test.go' appear (lines 800-803). This exercises the UI-visible expansion behavior. However, the test uses a mocked route (lines 511-531) with path-query routing, and does NOT verify the actual GET /agents/{agent}/files/tree?path=src network call or 200 status. Partial because child rendering is verified but network contract is not.

assertions.title: Expanding a directory twice does not re-fetch
assertions.notes: No spec verifies directory cache behavior. agent-review-journey.spec.ts Step 9 expands 'src' only once. Verifying no duplicate network call for the same path would require a request counter/listener, which is not present in any spec.

assertions.title: Folder collapse hides children
assertions.notes: Step 9 of agent-review-journey.spec.ts expands 'src' but never clicks it a second time to collapse. No spec exercises the collapse behavior nor verifies child entries disappear from the DOM after collapsing a folder.

assertions.title: Empty directory shows no children
assertions.notes: No spec tests the empty directory path — mocked routes in agent-review-journey.spec.ts always return directories with entries. Empty-directory rendering (no children, no error state) is not exercised.

assertions.title: Clicking a file opens it in editor
test_names: Step 9: Files tab renders file explorer
assertions.notes: Step 9 clicks auth.go (lines 807-811), asserts the editor shows 'src/auth.go' path (line 814), and confirms the 'Select a file to edit' placeholder is hidden (lines 816-818). This verifies the core open-in-editor behavior. However, the test does NOT verify: (a) the file is highlighted/selected in the tree, (b) syntax highlighting is applied to the content, (c) the GET /files?path=src/auth.go network call. Partial coverage.

assertions.title: File editor displays path and unsaved indicator
assertions.notes: Step 9 shows the file path ('src/auth.go') is rendered but does not verify the unsaved/dirty indicator element is present in the editor chrome. No spec asserts the dirty indicator visibility or its toggle behavior.

assertions.title: Editor detects language by file extension
assertions.notes: No spec verifies CodeMirror language detection. Step 9 opens a single .go file but does not assert syntax-highlighting CSS classes or language-mode attributes. Other extensions (.ts, .json, .md, .yaml, .yml) are not exercised at all.

assertions.title: Line numbers visible in editor
assertions.notes: No spec asserts the presence of the CodeMirror line-number gutter or its numeric content. Step 9 only checks the file path text is visible.

assertions.title: Search panel opens with cmd+F
assertions.notes: No spec tests CodeMirror's search panel lifecycle. keyboard-global-shortcuts.spec.ts does not cover cmd+F in the file editor context.

assertions.title: Search highlights all matches
assertions.notes: No spec exercises CodeMirror search highlighting in the file editor.

assertions.title: Search result navigation with Enter/arrows
assertions.notes: No spec exercises search result navigation (Enter/arrows) in the file editor.

assertions.title: Search panel closes with Escape
assertions.notes: keyboard-escape-layers.spec.ts handles generic Escape behavior but does not cover the file editor's CodeMirror search-panel-close-on-Escape.

assertions.title: Typing in editor marks file as dirty
assertions.notes: No spec types content into the CodeMirror file editor or asserts the dirty state indicator appears.

assertions.title: Save button disabled when file is not dirty
assertions.notes: No spec exercises the Save button's disabled state when a freshly opened file has no edits.

assertions.title: Save button enabled when file is dirty
assertions.notes: No spec types into the editor and then asserts the Save button is enabled.

assertions.title: cmd+S saves the file
assertions.notes: No spec tests cmd+S/ctrl+S save shortcut in the file editor, nor PUT /api/.../files?path={filePath} network verification.

assertions.title: Click Save button saves the file
assertions.notes: No spec clicks the Save button and verifies the PUT request, toast, and dirty indicator clearing.

assertions.title: Save success shows toast notification
assertions.notes: toast-notifications.spec.ts does not cover the file-save success toast. No spec asserts this toast appears after a successful save.

assertions.title: Save button shows 'Saving...' during request
assertions.notes: No spec asserts the transient 'Saving...' label on the Save button during an in-flight PUT request.

assertions.title: Binary files display read-only message
assertions.notes: No spec opens a binary file and verifies the read-only message is shown. Binary detection is tested in files_test.go (Go unit tests) but that does not exercise the frontend rendering.

assertions.title: Read-only mode disables editing
assertions.notes: No spec verifies CodeMirror's readOnly extension prevents keystroke-driven edits on binary files.

assertions.title: Read-only file has no Save button
assertions.notes: No spec verifies Save button is hidden or absent when a read-only/binary file is loaded.

assertions.title: Syntax highlighting works on read-only files
assertions.notes: No spec verifies that syntax highlighting classes are still applied to read-only file content.

assertions.title: Filter input narrows visible tree entries
assertions.notes: No spec tests the tree filter input narrowing behavior.

assertions.title: Filter narrows with parent folder visibility
assertions.notes: No spec verifies parent folders stay visible when a child matches the filter.

assertions.title: Filter with zero matches shows 'No matches' message
assertions.notes: No spec verifies the 'No matches' empty-state message when no tree entry matches the filter.

assertions.title: Clearing filter restores full tree
assertions.notes: No spec tests clearing the filter input and verifying the full tree is restored.

assertions.title: Filter text is debounced (200ms)
assertions.notes: No spec verifies the filter input's 200ms debounce timing.

assertions.title: Large file (>5MB) loads with warning or is rejected
assertions.notes: No spec exercises opening a >5MB file or verifies warning/rejection UI. files_coverage_test.go covers size limits at the Go layer but not the frontend behavior.

assertions.title: Opening file while another saves does not conflict
assertions.notes: No spec exercises concurrent file open/save operations to verify state isolation. concurrent-ops.integration.spec.ts covers unrelated concurrent scenarios.

assertions.title: Editors dropdown fetches detected editors
assertions.notes: No spec exercises the OpenInEditor dropdown that fetches /api/editors. editors_test.go covers the handler at the Go layer but not the frontend dropdown.

assertions.title: Selecting editor launches it with file path
assertions.notes: No spec clicks an editor in the OpenInEditor dropdown and verifies the POST /api/editors/open call with the current file path.

assertions.title: Navigating with unsaved changes shows warning
assertions.notes: No spec types to dirty the editor, clicks a different tree entry, and verifies the unsaved-changes warning dialog appears. paste-confirm-dialog.spec.ts is unrelated.

assertions.title: Discard in unsaved warning proceeds to new file
assertions.notes: No spec exercises the Discard action in the unsaved-changes dialog.

assertions.title: Keep Editing in unsaved warning stays on current file
assertions.notes: No spec exercises the Keep Editing action in the unsaved-changes dialog.

assertions.title: Go file syntax highlighting
assertions.notes: Step 9 opens a .go file but does not assert CodeMirror Go language highlighting classes (e.g., .tok-keyword for 'func'/'package').

assertions.title: JSON file syntax highlighting
assertions.notes: No spec opens a .json file in the editor or verifies JSON syntax highlighting.

assertions.title: Markdown file syntax highlighting
assertions.notes: No spec opens a .md file in the editor or verifies Markdown syntax highlighting. README.md is listed in the tree but never clicked.

assertions.title: YAML file syntax highlighting
assertions.notes: No spec opens a .yaml/.yml file in the editor or verifies YAML syntax highlighting.

assertions.title: Unknown extension renders as plain text
assertions.notes: No spec opens a file with an unknown extension to verify plain-text fallback rendering.

assertions.title: UTF-8 file displays correctly
assertions.notes: No spec opens a UTF-8 file with multi-byte characters and asserts correct rendering in the editor.

assertions.title: UTF-16 file shows warning or error
assertions.notes: No spec opens a UTF-16 file to verify warning/error handling.

assertions.title: Symlink folder is refused
assertions.notes: files_test.go covers symlink refusal at the Go handler layer, but no Playwright spec exercises the frontend behavior when the API returns a symlink-refused error.

assertions.title: File not found during editing
assertions.notes: No spec simulates a file being deleted during editing or verifies the frontend's 404 handling in the editor.

assertions.title: Rapid file switching does not cause race condition
assertions.notes: No spec exercises rapid file clicks in the tree to verify the editor settles on the last-clicked file without displaying stale content.

assertions.title: GET /agents/{agent}/files/tree network error shows fallback
assertions.notes: No spec mocks a failed tree request and verifies the fallback UI (error message, retry option) in the file tree.

assertions.title: GET /agents/{agent}/files network error shows editor error
assertions.notes: No spec mocks a failed file-content request and verifies the editor displays a read error to the user.

assertions.title: POST /api/editors/open failure is shown in OpenInEditor menu
assertions.notes: No spec mocks a failed POST /api/editors/open and verifies the OpenInEditor menu shows an error.

assertions.title: Editor is keyboard accessible
assertions.notes: keyboard-focus-management.spec.ts and keyboard-global-shortcuts.spec.ts do not cover the file editor surface. No spec verifies Tab reaches the tree, editor, and Save button in a logical order, nor that arrow keys navigate the tree.
